Name: (Unofficial) Nyapu Style Portraits for The Farmer's Children Deluxe Art
Author: nymnomicon
Description:
Did you update your Farmer's Children and add the Nyapu portraits only to find out the newest version of their portraits are only standard, meaning no unique costumes or hair choices for girls or custom hair colours for SVE and other characters? Me too! This mod uses Nyapu's art from a previous version of the mod with several edits and tweaks to fit in the newest version of The Farmer's Children. Including; Spirits Eve, Flower Dance, Egg Festival, and Winter Star outfits brought back and up to date for both genders, AND, all new Luau and SV Fair outfits for both children. Along with the built-in SVE compatibility, it also includes Wizard recolours and Marlon recolours. (Will be uploading my Marlon Nyapu style sprites for Make Marlon Real.) 

This mod replaces the Farmer's Children deluxe art using content patcher, please only have this folder in with the og mod or it will cause problems!

Please keep in mind I haven't fully been able to test everything out sprite wise, please let me know if something is missing or broken and I will do my best to fix it! All credits for the art goes to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491?tab=files]Nyapu[/url] for their amazing sprites. You need the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5436?tab=description]The Farmers Children[/url] mod in order to use this one. Please also do let me know if you have requests for more characters and I will try to get them done. 

*The only examples are Wizard children due to how long it takes to get to the child stage
